introduction: Alaska Unemployment Insurance takes initial claims through myAlaska. Once a claim is open, weekly filings and the state’s eligibility instructions determine which weeks can be paid.

who: The state reviews wages and the circumstances of unemployment. Workers unemployed or working less than full time can apply for a determination.
You must generally be able and available for suitable full-time work and follow the work-search instructions unless told otherwise. Report barriers that affect accepting work.
sections.get: The monetary determination sets the potential weekly payment and duration. Actual payment also requires weekly eligibility; a monetary determination alone is not approval for every week.
sections.docs: Prepare your Social Security number, last employer’s contact details, employment dates, last-week hours and gross earnings, and any severance, vacation or retirement information. The state also identifies immigration/work authorization information where applicable and special federal or military records for recent service.
sections.apply:
1. Sign into myAlaska and choose Unemployment Insurance Benefits. An existing myAlaska account can be used.
  2. File a new claim or reopen the existing claim as appropriate. Complete the final certification and save the confirmation number.
  3. Read all instructions, including any request to contact the claim center. Continue weekly filings and the required work search.
sections.after: Use the claim system to check status and maintain payment details. A representative contacts you if more information is needed. Review determinations and any appeal deadline. Keep records of earnings and work searches for each claimed week.

faqs: Do I need a separate myAlaska account?
Use your existing myAlaska account if you already have one. Reset a forgotten password before starting.
How do I know the initial claim went through?
The state says a confirmation number at the end means the application was accepted for processing.
Yes. Current online guidance requires a filing each week after the claim is opened. Follow your account’s instructions.
The UI claim centers provide free interpreters on request. Check their contact page for current phone hours.
